parsed.explanation: No universal visitor-facing exposure is documented: no border screening, facility ban, or custody rule; legal recognition has a constitutional self-declaration floor, same-sex marriage is nationwide, and the capital shows visible acceptance (Pride since 1979, LGBT-friendly hubs). But severity inputs are heavy: police are documented as corrupt, extortion-prone and abusive toward gender-nonconforming people (tier-2 state-tolerated targeting reaching visitors), hundreds of transfemicides with a regional body warning of impunity, and an analysis that rights are rarely enjoyed in practice. Raw counts lack denominators and most killings are local-sphere, so this is not a documented campaign; no per-capita or border-friction evidence exists. The working-practice failure (impunity, weak enforcement) prevents crediting the strong paper protections, while their real existence keeps this out of the high-risk bands. Subnational variation (accepting capital/resort hubs vs. high-crime regions) averages toward mid-elevated.
